items.question: Is LLM-Translator free?
items.answer: Yes. LLM-Translator is open source under the Apache 2.0 license and free, including for commercial use. You can find the installers in the releases on {repoHost}.

items.question: Which platforms are supported?
items.answer: LLM-Translator runs on macOS (.dmg) and Windows (.exe). Since the source code is open, you can also build the app yourself.

items.question: Which AI models can I use?
items.answer: Any model available through an OpenAI-compatible API: OpenRouter, OpenAI, or locally via Ollama. You set the API URL, key and model in the settings.

items.question: Does translation work offline?
items.answer: Yes, with a local model, for example via Ollama. Cloud providers such as OpenRouter or OpenAI require an internet connection.

items.question: Do my texts stay private?
items.answer: With a local model, your texts never leave your computer. If you use a cloud provider, your texts are sent to that provider and its privacy terms apply.

items.question: Where can I get help or a customization?
items.answer: Report bugs and feature requests as an issue on {repoHost}. For custom development, such as your own branding or integration with your AI infrastructure, use the request in the pricing section.
